description.value:
Frequency once per day

Duration 1 minute

For the duration, you and your Feral Bond count as a single body for the purpose of your mutations: every Gift and every Tithe either of you carries applies to both of you simultaneously, Slot for Slot. When the minute ends, the fusion releases cleanly — no extra Strain, no Bloom roll, just two bodies that spent a minute agreeing they were one.
